summary: Feed s122_double is degraded: 73% encrypted traffic exceeds IDS 60% tolerance and 4.3% jumbo frames (up to 8058B) exceed IDS 1518B MTU and are dropped.

findings.root_cause: 73% of bytes are encrypted (TLS) forwarded without decryption; IDS tolerates ~60%. Packet broker is mirroring encrypted traffic directly without SSL visibility/decryption layer.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS cannot inspect payloads for signatures/anomaly detection on ~73% of traffic, leaving only ~27% visible and significantly reducing detection coverage.

recommended_fix.why: Decrypting relevant TLS flows (or forwarding a decrypted copy from an SSL visibility appliance) before the IDS restores payload inspection capability within tool tolerance.

findings.root_cause: Network uses jumbo frames up to 8058 bytes while IDS port is limited to 1518 bytes standard MTU. Broker forwards frames unchanged without MTU handling.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS NIC silently drops 91 of 2093 frames (4.3%) that exceed MTU, causing missed detections, broken flow reassembly and incomplete IDS coverage for large-frame flows.

recommended_fix.why: Enabling jumbo MTU (9216) on IDS port prevents drops; if tool cannot support jumbos, configure broker to fragment or slice only oversize frames to preserve delivery while keeping full payload for normal frames which IDS requires.
